article.title: Procedure where codicil discovered after grant of administration with will annexed.
article.content: If, after the grant of letters of administration with the will annexed, a codicil is discovered, it may be added to the grant on due proof and identification, and the grant may be altered and amended accordingly.
article.html:
262Procedure where codicil discovered after grant of administration with will annexed.

Section 262 · Part IX · Chapter III · page 74 of the Act

If, after the grant of letters of administration with the will annexed, a codicil is discovered, it may be added to the grant on due proof and identification, and the grant may be altered and amended accordingly.
